about: Incremental recalculation (ADR-0047, SH-8; ADR-0048): what a change recomputes, in what order, and that a batch publishes its Values at once. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' RecalculationTests.

cases.name: ADR-0047 (SH-8): only the dependents of a change recompute, counted
ADR-0047 (SH-8): a change to a cell nothing reads recomputes nothing
ADR-0047 (SH-8): entering a Formula recomputes it and what reads it, not its precedents
ADR-0047: a diamond recomputes each cell once, after all of its precedents
ADR-0047: a long chain recomputes in dependency order without running out of stack
ADR-0047: a long chain entered in one batch recomputes in dependency order without running out of stack
ADR-0047 (SH-8): Values are published only from a completed recalculation
cases.note: A batch is one change and one recalculation: every Value it reports is from the end state, and none from a state between its parts.

cases.name: ADR-0048: opening a document computes every Value again, cycles included
